fields.statement: At bb492482 I read the diff (plan.toml: interview on.pass -> milestone-check, a command step running `rhiza run milestone-check` with on.pass review and no on.fail; internal/api/run_milestone.go fails naming each plan change set serving no milestone directly or via an intent under one, with a Fix line) and ran: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestRunMilestoneCheck (PASS: fails serving nothing and serving an intent under no milestone, passes through an intent under a milestone and serving a milestone directly); go test ./internal/workflow/... (PASS, TestPlanBuiltin covers milestone-check pass->review and fail->EndFailed); go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ plan-milestone-check, plan-workflow, plan-workflow-pr, plan-workflow-autonomous, plan-workflow-autonomous-left, plan-workflow-open, arbiter-agent-tabs, describe-golden (ok). plan-milestone-check.txtar runs a plan run whose fake interview agent stays live (sleep) after `rhiza session done` and links its new change set to an intent under no milestone: the run exits non-zero, failed at step milestone-check, status --json names the change set, no review visit and no reviewer prompt; plan-workflow.txtar with the intent marked milestone=1 shows milestone-check pass, then review.
